caption: Ever notice your ankles feel stiffer after a long walk? Try these small steps: take a short break to stretch, wear shoes that fit well, and walk on different surfaces
comments_seeded: What do you think causes ankle stiffness after walking?
I've heard that cold weather can make joints feel stiffer, is that true for ankles too?
How often do you take breaks to stretch when you're out for a walk?
Just a reminder, listening to your body and taking care of your joints can make a big difference in how you feel
Have you ever tried changing your walking route to see if it affects your ankle stiffness?
